title: ClueCon 2024
html:
ClueCon, the annual conference organized by Signalwire FreeSWITCH developers, takes place as usual in Chicago, USA, during August 12-15, 2024.

We expect a good representation of Kamailio community, several with presentations or tutorials, among them:

  • Fred Posner
  • Elena-Ramona Modroiu
  • Mack Hendricks
  • Daniel-Constantin Mierla

Schedule and more details are available on the event website:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
